thermal.preheat.function_zh: 装池前预热；step推进，不能装冷池后密封加热

sample.configure.function_zh: 宿主装入干燥/已审查固体；六位置必须同容量

acquisition.start.function_zh: 密封、气密代理、充液、分级升压、保持、排液、最终冲洗/氮吹、解封

acquisition.stop.function_zh: 暂停/取消主动动作；保留残压/库存，热和传质继续

acquisition.abort.function_zh: 宿主有序终止：排液、氮吹、解封；不是第三次急停固件

extraction.measure.function_zh: 理想读数及阶段；不是校准仪表

product.read.function_zh: 宿主条件回收率与真实跨仪器参考比值分开

reference.lookup.function_zh: 54真实ASE/Soxtec比较数据，不能当本机绝对回收率

sample.unload.function_zh: 完整或有序终止后，开屏抽块，用夹具取池

power.enabled.meaning_zh: 主电源开关状态（true=通电）；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

shield.lift_m.meaning_zh: 上推安全屏（shield）沿 +Z 上推的位移，范围 0–0.18 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

drawer.extension_m.meaning_zh: 加热块滑轨托板（heater_drawer）沿 −Y 抽出的位移，范围 0–0.16 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

heater.lift_m.meaning_zh: 加热块（heater_lift）沿 +Z 自动升降的位移（密封萃取池），范围 0–0.035 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

pressurized_extraction.meaning_zh: 同容量六池有限溶剂与目标物守恒、条件分配与传质
equations: four stock liquid volume ledgers: initial=reservoir+cell+vial+waste+removed; reference density fixed, thermal expansion neglected
one total pump1..50mL/min divided by6; inactive positions reduce effective method flow, exact factory algorithm unknown
host degradation first order conservatively moves sorbed/dissolved target to degraded ledger; extract cooled proxy no degradation
preheat first; seal3.5s, nitrogen tightness proxy10s, finite fill, staged pressure1/3,2/3,full; intrinsic dwell proxy10s*(cell_volume/20mL)
hold and discharge each0..3600s;1..10cycles; discharge NO nitrogen, final optional solvent0..540s and mandatory N2 60..1800s
finite host nitrogen molar stock flows only tightness/final nitrogen, never creates liquid; nitrogen push moves residual liquid to collection not evaporation
pressure hydraulic first-order target and discharge decay, not mass-derived compressible EOS; pressure<=1bar before automatic release
pause closes active flows but thermal/partition/degradation continue; ordered abort drains/purges/releases then cancelled complete

limitations: 几何以2019G手册多视图约束；所有局部尺寸、滑动/升降行程、质量惯量摩擦未实测。URDF质量仅稳定占位。
当前4端口、6等容量池、240mL收集瓶代理；热块前后滑动/升降、屏向上、收集架升降为教学机械动作。
仅已干燥/分散的固体痕量分析物；基质不溶解、无颗粒夹带和非理想溶胀；分配Kd、传质、溶解度、温度依赖/降解由宿主给定，非实机标定。
纯溶剂饱和蒸气压参考加理想Raoult近似；温度独立热惯性、压力独立有界液压响应，未做完整可压缩混合物EOS或能量平衡。
氮气/液体排放与设施安全需专业审核；模型互锁不能用于真实高温高压设备控制。
宿主装样、收集和卸样事件不等于机器人抓取、针刺隔膜或软管/密封约束。
调研表外廓待补；2019G手册W/H/D670/725/500mm及2025安装清单W/D/H670/500/725mm一致，几何按0.67/0.50/0.725m。2019D技术表W/D/H670/780/500mm保留为未消除排序/版本冲突，不静默交换780/500。
2019G手册90kg，2019D技术表E916为98kg，2025安装清单承重按最大/约98kg。实际配置整机质量仍null，两文献数值单独保留，不分摊给部件。
E916是6位10/20/40mL；E916XL60mL与E914四位10–120mL不是本配置。不可混装不同尺寸的池；一实例整组选择同容量。
厂家同时有2和4溶剂端口配置；本资产明确选择4端口子配置，不冒充所有SKU。
收集架标准包含，但收集瓶要另购；本几何选240mL瓶教学代理，60/150/220mL及中途换瓶不自动宣称已实现。
1–50mL/min为单HPLC泵总能力，不是每孔50mL/min；方法运行自动分流，部分位置关闭时与独立FLUSH服务模式缩放不同。
加热块必须先预热再装池；关闭状态改变温度可能损坏杯形密封，不能把冷装样后整机升温作为默认正规过程。
HEAT-UP由控制器根据条件决定，用户不能设置厂家精确时长；宿主热响应和1/3、2/3压力台阶为显式工程近似。
起始氮气TIGHTNESS TEST不是单独约5min的LEAK TEST；不把前者通过当完整泄漏验收。
DISCHARGE每循环靠压差排液，不用氮气；末尾FLUSH WITH GAS独立，E916至少60s，不套E914至少120s。
HOLD/DISCHARGE各0–60min，末尾溶剂冲洗0–9min，氮吹1–30min，循环1–10；设置零排液时间不等于实际已排空。
氮气入口6–10bar为供应范围，不是50–150bar萃取压力；零点校准需泄压，模型将面板压力解释为表压并明确绝压换算。
200bar±20bar机械保护和260C±10C过温保护不是正常方法上限；真实安全装置不作数值认证。
STOP一次暂停、两次有序排液/氮吹中止、三次立即停在当前位置；不是一种静默回滚或瞬时安全清空。
手册叙述与面板说明对两次STOP是否同时溶剂冲洗措辞略有不同；中止至少有排液/氮吹，并明确不保证真实固件完整顺序。
6个冷却单元是内部出液冷却，不需要虚构外置真空泵或循环浴；下游Syncore/Multivapor蒸发设备未接入。
AN317真实回收比以Soxtec为分母，允许大于100%，不是绝对质量收率或分配系数；原ASE200/11或22mL/二氯甲烷-丙酮条件不能当E916标定。
AN317原表Acenaphthalene和bis(Chlorethoxy)methane名称有歧义，保留排除记录而不推定CAS；其余54种也不编造未核验CAS。
AN317分土壤RSD是总体统计，不能当每种物质单独不确定度或生成真实重复测量。
E916厂家农药报告需提交联系方式；未提交或绕过表单。AN317官网工具域本地403，同厂Fisher公开镜像成功缓存。
四溶剂纯流体EOS拟合不等于真实混合物相图；理想Raoult估算不含共沸、活度或基质影响。
CoolProp7.2.0旧ancillary误差标记与当前EOS归档网格不一致：甲醇最大0.4644%、正己烷1.2128%；原因未独立确定。运行层改用140点EOS对数插值，并对136个独立中点验证<0.2%；不是原拟合精度背书。
54measured AN317 ratios compare Dionex ASE200 with Soxtec and may exceed1; NOT E916 absolute recoveries,partition coefficients or transfer constants. No measured E916 calibration available.
54names have unresolved CAS; two ambiguous source names excluded. Original DCM/acetone reference recipe is not the four-solvent runtime subset.
Host supplies Kd,transfer,activation,solubility,degradation,thermal lag,pressure lag,discharge and holdup. These are synthetic assumptions,not inferred from recovery ratios.
Four-port E916 selected,10/20/40mL equal-capacity runtime groups; current geometry only20mL proxy and separately purchased240mL bottles. Mixed capacities and changing vials between cycles absent.

140pure-solvent EOS nodes and136heldout midpoint log-interpolation tests; ideal mole-fraction Raoult only; nonideal mixing,boiling,gas dissolution,thermal expansion and complete energy balance not implemented. Fill/discharge transient two-phase behavior absent; model does not certify real safety.

Pressure lag is independent of fluid compressibility; per-cell pressure sensors ideal,not manufacturer accuracy/noise calibration. Initial nitrogen test checks host connections,not actual leak or five-minute liquid LEAK procedure.

Six cells equal nominal division total/6 is an explicit flow assumption; factory active-position flow algorithm not independently known. Standalone service FLUSH50mL/min differs and is not implemented.

All product-directed liquid captured in selected bottle until finite capacity; waste ports are visible but selectable waste/service routing absent. N2 transports residual liquid,not solvent evaporation or aerosol entrainment.
No cell cleaning,wet-sample drying,polymer precipitation,clogging,needle puncture,thread torque,real pressure seal contact,robot pickup or hardware USB/control. One batch per instance.

Pause/resume and host ordered abort implemented; exact one/two/three STOP button timing and third-press immediate assembly freezing not implemented. No automatic recovery from failed supply/vial/pressure safety guards.
Cold loading forbidden; hot unload requires host gripper confirmation only,not a simulated thermal-contact safety guarantee. All safety interlocks are teaching subset,not certified.
Four joint strokes and all local component dimensions/masses unknown estimates. 90kg/98kg and datasheet dimension conflicts retained; actual total mass null.
Agent truth filtering and nativeSession async are tested separately from Matterix outer ack; no deployment isolation or robot constraint.
